decided.point: No: keep required pre-merge review and do not move to pushing straight to main.
decided.detail: Faster review turnaround or smaller branches may be noted as worth borrowing.

why.point: Dropping required, recorded pre-merge review would break the Halvorsen grant's condition that every change is reviewed by a second person with an auditable record, which pays for maintenance.
why.detail: Grant agreement section 4.2; the approving review on each pull request is the record.

next.point: Nothing changes in the workflow; the question reopens only if the grant's review condition changes or goes away.
